items.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Check the existing archive directory's permissions**

When `run/stale` already exists as a directory but is not writable/searchable, this condition passes because it checks only the directory's type and the parent `run_dir`'s write bit. The command then disables delivery and removes the identity before `mv` fails under `set -e`, recreating the exact inconsistent state this preflight is intended to prevent: the placement record remains under `spawn.*` but is no longer discoverable through identities. Validate write/search access on an existing `stale` directory, as well as search access on its parent, before cleanup.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L75-L78](https://github.com/mryfmo/dotfiles/blob/4fa993298d6a09008925521531a42e1b10761df0/AGENTS.md#L75-L78)

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
